handback.summary: Docs and the settings format now list the only three agent keys allowed; job and audit refusal kept.

criteria.896.1: `role_settings` in `dokima/agents.py` stops on any key outside `DECLARED`, the keys `entry.yml` declares.
criteria.896.2: `compare_secrets` in `dokima/audit.py` gives the one line from `agents.undeclared` for an undeclared key.
criteria.896.3: The job's key lookup raises `Stop` with that same line before checking whether the secret is present.
criteria.896.4: `README.md`, `docs/wiki/Installing.md` and the `dokima/agents.py` docstring name the three keys and say others never reach jobs.

raises.label: Tests left out
raises.text: Two older test files name undeclared keys and are not in the plan's test changes, so the full suite fails once they are restored.
